question: The European Commission’s proposal for the post-2027 CAP provides for mandatory degressive payments and caps annual area support at EUR 100 000 per farm. The Commission is planning to introduce 25 % and 50 % reductions for payments in the EUR 20 000-50 000 and EUR 50 000-75 000 ranges respectively, while any sums exceeding the EUR 75 000 threshold will be scaled back by 75 %.

Farms in Romania vary in size, production structure and economic capacity. Some combine crops with livestock farming, while others operate in regions with specific natural and economic constraints. 1.
Has the Commission assessed the impact of its proposal on the economic viability and capacity for modernisation of Romanian farms of all types and sizes?
What safeguards will be put in place to ensure that farms whose size is justified by production structure, number of employees or investment needs are not disproportionately penalised?
How will the Commission ensure that Member States can take into account labour costs, employment, farm structure and regional constraints for the purposes of adjusting income support?
